text:
Maya: heads-up — console flagged a ~2.1M drop in daily active events for the billing-agg pipeline starting ~00:30 UTC. looks like late arrival from the EU ingest cluster. thinking a targeted replay for that 00:00–01:00 window. low-risk approach: mini-batch + dry-run -> compare aggregates.
Priya: +1. can we sample tenants first? run a 1% canary to validate dedupe/ordering edgecases. important: our agg job dedupes on event_id but the late events sometimes get new ids. need to check canonicalization.
Liam: console shows replay-quota at 12% remaining for the priority lane. if we burn that we impact other backfills. propose: use dedicated mini-batch token with `--tenant-scope` so we don't touch global priority quota. cc @Priya for tenant list.
Jon: can we do `--dry-run` + `--emit-metrics=true` to feed the console diff UI? that would let Product verify expected bumps without committing writes. small command I usually use: `./replay-cli run --start 2026-03-19T00:00Z --end 2026-03-19T01:00Z --tenant-scope=sample10 --dry-run --emit-metrics`
Priya: good. also add `--idempotency-check` flag (newer replay binary) so we catch late double-inserts. we'll run a quick SQL against events_raw: `SELECT count(*) FROM events_raw WHERE ingested_at BETWEEN '2026-03-19 00:00' AND '2026-03-19 01:00' AND region='eu';` to confirm raw volume.
Maya: thanks. Probable operator flow: 1) canary 1% tenants dry-run with emit-metrics 2) compare console diffs 3) if matches, escalate to 10% non-dry-run with rate-limit 4) full backfill if green. Need signoff from oncall for non-dry-run.
Avery: oncall ok to approve canary dry-run now, but please ping me before any non-dry-run. I'll watch job traces and SLO pages.
Liam: FYI, KV-cache warmup matters — if replay touches aggregates it can thrash read caches. add `--kv-warmup=200` to slow ramp. small snippet for operator: ```
# canary dry-run
./replay-cli run \
  --start 2026-03-19T00:00Z \
  --end 2026-03-19T01:00Z \
  --tenant-scope=canary-1pct \
  --dry-run \
  --emit-metrics \
  --kv-warmup=200
```
Jon: thanks. one more: console estimator currently undercounts corner-case merges. I'll attach the canary tag to the replay so console can surface the diff separately: `tags: ["canary:eu-00-01", "initiator:maya"]`.
Maya: putting tenant list in this thread: `acme-inc, beta-co, gamma-llc` (sample set). Priya — can you run the raw-count query and paste numbers before I kick the canary?
Priya: raw-count is ~12,430 for that window in eu. historical median for same window is ~14,600. so ~15% shortfall. good target.
Maya: ok starting canary dry-run in 2m. I'll create a replay job with `dry-run=true` and `emit-metrics=true`. tagging it `canary-eu-00-01`.
replay-bot: replay job created -> id=job_20260319_0000_canary, status=scheduled, owner=Maya. ETA to start: 90s. console-link: https://console/internal/replays/job_20260319_0000_canary
Avery: watching. set my timezone alarm. if error rate > 1% or latency spikes on agg-service, cancel.
Jon: once dry-run completes, export `console/diff` and share. I can run the compare script: `scripts/compare-diff --job job_20260319_0000_canary`
Maya: canary started. pinging this thread with link to console diff when ready. :eyes:
(replay-bot): job job_20260319_0000_canary started on runner-14, exec=./replay-core v1.7.2
Priya: dry-run finished. console-diff shows +12,300 events, aggregate bump lines up with raw-count. diffs look clean; no duplicate-id churn observed.
Liam: great. recommend moving to 10% non-dry-run but add `--rate-limit=50rps` and `--preflight-check=1` so we monitor for regressions. also allocate a temporary quota token from `quota-pool:ops-temp-3` to avoid stealing global priority quota.
Avery: approved for 10% non-dry-run with rate-limit and quota token. I'll be on pager for the next 60m.
Maya: launching 10% non-dry-run now with rate-limit and token. job id=job_20260319_0000_stage1. replay-bot: created.
replay-bot: job job_20260319_0000_stage1 queued, token=ops-temp-3, rate-limit=50rps.
Jon: monitor console diff, open an incident if aggregate variance > 0.5% from expected after each batch. I'll watch the A/B metrics dashboard.
Priya: stage1 progress at 18% after 12m, no dupes, KV miss rate stable.
Maya: stage1 completed. diffs match expected. scheduling full window run at reduced concurrency overnight to avoid peak.
Liam: one ops-note for followups: add a UI checkbox in the console to reserve a temporary quota token for backfills (so we don't have to juggle pool names in chat). filing a tiny ticket for Console UX.
Maya: ticket would be great. thanks everyone. closing this thread — will post postmortem if anything odd pops up. :thumbsup:
